Privacy Policy

Last updated: 4 November 2026

1. Who we are

Algarithm ("we", "us", "our") is a UK-based marketing agency that runs paid advertising and conversion tracking for clinics in the UK and United States. We are the data controller for the personal information described in this policy. You can contact us at info@algarithm.co.uk.

2. Information we collect

Information you give us. When you request or book a call through our booking form or a Facebook or Instagram lead form, we collect your name, email address, phone number, business name and your answers to the form's questions. If you tick the optional SMS consent box, we also record that consent and when it was given.

Information collected automatically. When you visit our website, we collect your IP address, browser type, referring page, ad campaign parameters, pages viewed and actions you take (such as clicking a button or booking a call). We collect this using cookies, pixels and similar technologies.

3. How we use your information

We use your information to:

  • Schedule and confirm your call and send you reminders
  • Contact you by email, phone and, if you opted in, text message about your booking and our services
  • Prepare for your call so we can tailor it to your business
  • Measure and improve our advertising and website
  • Keep records and meet our legal obligations

Under UK and EU data protection law, we rely on your consent (for text messages and non-essential cookies), our legitimate interests (responding to your enquiry, running and improving our business) and legal obligations.

4. Text messages (SMS)

If you tick the optional SMS consent box when booking a call, you agree to receive text messages from Algarithm about your booking (confirmations and reminders) and about our services. The box is unchecked by default. Consent to receive texts is not required to book a call or to buy any service.

Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP at any time to opt out, or HELP for help. You can also contact us at info@algarithm.co.uk. Full SMS terms are in our Terms and Conditions at us.algarithm.co.uk/terms/.

We do not sell, rent or share your mobile number, SMS opt-in data or text messaging consent with any third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. Mobile information may be shared only with service providers that help us deliver our messages, such as our messaging platform (HighLevel/LeadConnector), and never for their own use.

5. Who we share information with

We share personal information only with service providers that help us run our business:

  • HighLevel (LeadConnector): our booking calendar, CRM and messaging platform
  • Meta Platforms, Inc.: advertising and measurement through the Meta Pixel and Conversions API. Contact details are hashed (scrambled) before they are sent.
  • Our website host: to serve our web pages and keep server logs
  • Google: to load fonts, and YouTube to play videos you choose to watch, in privacy-enhanced mode

We may also disclose information if required by law, or to a buyer or successor if our business is merged or sold. We do not sell personal information for money.

The above excludes text messaging originator opt-in data and consent; this information will not be shared with any third parties.

6. Cookies and advertising

We use cookies and pixels to measure our ads and understand how people use our website. In the UK and EEA, we ask for your consent before setting non-essential cookies. You can manage how Meta uses your data in your Meta ad preferences, and block cookies in your browser settings.

7. International transfers

Your information may be processed in the United States and other countries. Where we transfer data outside the UK or EEA, we rely on appropriate safeguards recognised under UK or EU law.

8. How long we keep information

We keep your information for as long as we have a business relationship with you and for up to three years after our last contact, unless the law requires us to keep it longer.

9. Security

We use reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your information. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

10. Your rights

UK and EEA residents have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict or object to the use of their information, to data portability, and to withdraw consent at any time. You can also complain to the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) or your local data protection authority.

US residents, including those in California, Colorado, Connecticut, Virginia and Texas, may have the right to know what we collect, to correct or delete it, and to opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information or targeted advertising. We honour Global Privacy Control signals. An authorised agent may make a request on your behalf.

To make a request, email info@algarithm.co.uk.

11. Children

Our services are for businesses and are not directed at anyone under 18.

12. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date at the top shows when it last changed.

13. Contact us

Questions about this policy or your information? Email us at info@algarithm.co.uk.
